name: direction-aware-hover
title: Direction Aware Hover
description: Square image cards on a black page. Entering one from a side shifts the photo and its caption a little in opposite directions, darkens the picture and fades in a white label at the bottom-left.
use: A gallery of people or destinations where captions should stay hidden until someone points at a card.
avoid: Touch screens: the caption and dark veil appear on hover only.
a11y: Captions appear only on mouse hover, so keyboard and touch users never see them; alt text is just the word image. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three square rounded image cards on black: a black-and-white swirl of contour lines, a bright office interior and a sky full of clouds. Each sits flat at rest, and a hovered one carries a dark veil with a small white label at its bottom-left.
behaves: Entering a card from above, below, left or right nudges the image and the overlay text a few pixels in opposite directions, fades in a dark veil and reveals the label. Leaving reverses it.
customise: Pass imageUrl plus overlay content as children; imageClassName, childrenClassName and className tune styling, while the nudge distances are fixed.
weight: light: A few image cards with short transform and opacity transitions; no loop.
